summary_en: 1,110,000 shares (3.7% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired up to ¥1.0B via open-market purchase on TSE from 17 Aug 2026 to 13 Nov 2026. Price ceiling not disclosed. Rationale: improve capital efficiency in response to market valuation and current stock price.
title_en: Notification of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, Gifty Group held a board meeting and resolved to acquire its own shares. The program authorizes the company to acquire up to 1,110,000 shares of its ordinary stock, representing 3.7% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for a maximum outlay of ¥1.0 billion. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchase (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 17 August 2026 to 13 November 2026. The company stated that it is implementing this opportunistic buyback to improve capital efficiency in light of market valuation and current stock-price levels. No price ceiling was disclosed. As of 30 June 2026, the company held zero treasury shares and had 29,841,139 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
